name: 1-kb-kettlebell-push-press
instructions:
1. Set up the kettlebell at chest height in the front rack position.
2. Dip slightly at the knees and then explode straight up as you press the kettlebell overhead.
3. Lower the bell back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
